text: Hello, boys and girls, welcome to Yvonne's class.Today, we'll learn the more practice section in Unit 3, and read some interesting stories.These are what you are expected to learn in today's lesson.Please get your textbook and worksheet ready.First, please read the following sentences and guess what they refer to.In Paul's diary, they met the next fairy in time and helped to deal with the theft.In the grammar lesson, we read a story about the world's first pizza robbery.They arrived and caught the members of pizza gang.In the listening lesson, they asked the woman to describe the other two thieves.Do you know what they refer to?Right, they are policemen.Are you familiar with this job?Do you know what policemen do at their daily work?I think most of you are familiar with the police work, because we can see policemen almost everywhere.They keep our city a safe place.If some cases occur, they must arrive in time and deal with them.That means they need to deal with different cases.Read after me.What kind of case do you know?Let's look at some pictures.The woman is trying to steal the clothes.It is a theft.The man is robbing the bank.It is a robbery.Look at this picture.What is the man doing?He is trying to carry something that is not allowed by the law through customs.Carry something that is not allowed by the law means smuggle something.So we call it a smuggling case.What else do policemen do?As the picture shows, they need to catch bad people.Here is another word which has the same meaning as catch.Arrest.The criminals means the bad people who commit the crimes.Criminal.In a theft, we call the criminal thief.In a robbery, we call the criminal robber.In a smuggling case, we call the criminal smuggler.Policemen have duty to arrest the criminals and protect the citizens.Besides these things, policemen also have much other work to do.What do you think of the police work?Let's think and share.Some of you may think it is dangerous as policemen need to face different criminals.Some of you may think it is hard or difficult, busy, important, honourable or maybe some of you think police work is boring.But do you think police work sometimes is funny?Today we'll read an article called The Funny Side of Police Work.Please read the introduction first and think about the question.What do you think the funny side of police work will be about?Have you got the answers?According to the introduction, we know that Paula interviewed Detective Smith and he told her some stories.Maybe the funny side of police work will be about some funny stories which happened when Detective Smith or his workmates dealt with different cases.Are you eager to read these funny stories?First, let's read the whole article and tell what case each story tells about.The funny side of police workWhat case is story A?Right, it is a theft.What about story B?Obviously, it is a robbery.What case is story C?A smuggling case, good job.Now, let's read these stories again and try to find out the funny side of police work.Please read story A and think about these two questions.Why is the word thief in the first sentence in quotation marks?Why did Detective Smith think it was a strange case?I think you have got the answers.Let's deal with the first question.We know that the word in quotation marks must have special meaning.In story A, thief is in quotation marks because the man was not a real thief.It was strange, wasn't it?Actually, Detective Smith also thought it was a strange case.From the story, we know that at the beginning,Detective Smith thought the man had stolen something in the clothes shop,so he arrested him.But later he found out the truth and soon released him.So the police arrested the man by mistake.They released him after they found out the truth.What happened?Let's find out the truth.There was a dialogue between Detective Smith and the man.Choose the right option to complete the dialogue.Here is a new word.RefundRefundNow take out your worksheet and finish task one.RefundRefundRefundRefundRefundRefundRefundRefundHave you got the answers?Let's check.RefundRefundWell done!The man was so funny and strange, wasn't he?Now what do you think the funny side of police work in Story 8 was?RefundOne of my students, Sam, wants to share his idea.Thank you, Sam.Now, let's move on to Story B.Story B is a real robbery.Please read it again and find out what the robber did.Pay attention to the verbs.First, the robber wrote some words on the back of the envelope.This is a robbery.Give me money.Then he gave it to the teller.The teller is the person who gives and receives money at a bank.The teller gave him $100,000.That means the robber got the money.Then he ran away.But he was arrested as soon as he got out of the lift.He admitted that he had robbed the bank.Admit.But he couldn't believe that the police found him so quickly.So why could the police find him so quickly?Yes, because the front of the envelope he used in the robbery had his name and address on it.The teller called the police soon and told this important information to the police.Thanks to this clever, calm and careful teller.What was the funny side of police work in Story B?Alice wants to share her idea.The bank robber was stupid and careless.He didn't know or notice that there was his name and address on the front of the envelope.He went home after the robbery.Yes, how stupid and careless the robber was.Let's read Story C again and think about these questions.The robber was stupid and careless.What was the funny side of police work in Story C?The front of the envelope he used in the robbery.I think you have got your answers.Who was the criminal?A man from Australia.What did he do?He tried to smuggle some rare birds from Thailand into Australia.Read the new word.Rare.Rare means unusual.How did he smuggle?He hid the birds inside a special pocket in his trousers.Was he arrested in the end?As he was going through customs, the birds started to sing.Although Detective Smith didn't tell the ending, but we can infer that, right?Now, can you add a possible ending to Story C?That's task two on your worksheet.Alice, can you share your writing?Good job, Alice.Now, let's think about this question again.What was the funny side of police work in this story?Sam, what's on your mind?The smuggler was unlucky and stupid too.Although he hid the birds in a special pocket, he forgot that the birds could also make sound.As he was going through customs, the birds sang.Maybe the birds were calling the police.Yes, the smuggler was stupid, but the birds were smart.Maybe they are calling the police for help.Class, we have finished reading these three stories which Detective Smith told Paula in the interview.Now, Paula is writing the article about the funny side of police work for her school newspaper.She has finished most of it, but unluckily, her pen leaks and some inkblots cover some of the words.Please help Paula filling the missing words and add an ending to complete her article.That's task three on your worksheet.Thank you for watching.First, let's find the missing words.Police men deal with different cases every day.Some people think their work must be difficult and dangerous.But today, I will tell you three funny stories about police work.The first one was about a funny man.The policeman arrested him in a clothes shop at first because he hid a yellow sweater inside his coat just like a thief.But later, the police found out the truth and released him soon.In fact, the yellow sweater was his birthday present from his wife, but he hated it.He just wanted to return it for a refund, but he didn't want his wife to see him.The second story was about a stupid robber.He robbed a bank.He wrote,This is a robbery.Give me money on the back of the envelope and give it to the teller.After he got the money, he ran away.But as soon as he got out of the lift, the police arrested him.In fact, the teller called the police and told them the robber's name and address because they were on the front of the envelope.The third story happened at the customs.A man wanted to smuggle some rare birds from Thailand into Australia.But the birds started to sing as he was going through customs.So he was arrested so quickly too.Well done class.Have you finished the ending?I want to share mine with you.As you can see, funny things sometimes happen at policemen's daily work.They meet with some strange people.They catch some stupid criminals.They deal with some interesting cases.That is the funny side of police work.That is my understanding to the funny side of police work.I think some of you must have the similar idea.And here is your homework.This is the end of today's lesson.Goodbye everyone.See you next time.
